name: Sem shagov za gorizont
source:
Welcome, pioneers… Before you lies the story of two people whom fate seemed eager to erase from this world, but, as if for a joke, decided to spare, throwing them into the farthest, dustiest drawer of life.

Semyon Persunov — an ordinary shut-in, a failure. His fulfilling life ended almost as soon as it began. His room is buried in trash and dust, the days long since melted into one gray blur. He hides in this chaos, hoping to find peace… but finds only emptiness.

Everything changes with a strange trip. Bus route 410. A camp. Summer. Too bright, too alive. As if it belonged to someone else’s reality. Yet it calls to him.

But, of course, everything is not that simple. Every night the nightmares return — fragments of memories, whispers, someone’s quiet sobs, the smell of blood. As though trying to remind him of something. Something important. So important it should never have been forgotten… Yet it was.

And this girl… Modest, with violet hair, whose name lingers on the tip of his tongue, a name he longs to repeat again and again, with a dreamy smile on his face: “Le-e-na…” She’s always somewhere nearby, blushing the moment his eyes meet hers. And with that, his heart begins to beat faster.

But time is short. Only a week remains until the end of the shift. And after that? Will he be thrown back into his cold world? Left here, in this strange summer fairy tale? Or… something else?

Although maybe, for him, it doesn’t matter. Maybe nothing will change anyway.
Because this girl has so little time left. Far too little…

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3533712894]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎，开拓者们……在你们面前讲述的是两个人的故事，命运似乎急于将他们从这个世界上抹去，但就像一个笑话一样，他们决定饶恕他们，把他们扔进生命最遥远、最尘土飞扬的抽屉里。

谢苗·佩尔苏诺夫（Semyon Persunov）——一个普通的闭关者，一个失败者。他充实的生活几乎刚开始就结束了。他的房间被垃圾和灰尘掩埋，日子早已融化成一片灰色的模糊。他躲在这片混乱之中，希望找到平静……却只找到空虚。

一切都随着一次陌生的旅行而改变。公交410路。一个营地。夏天。太明亮了，太有活力了。就好像它属于别人的现实一样。然而它召唤着他。

但是，当然，一切并没有那么简单。每天晚上，噩梦都会回来——记忆的碎片、低语、某人低声的抽泣、血腥味。仿佛想要提醒他什么。一些重要的事情。它如此重要，不应该被遗忘……但它确实如此。

而这个女孩……谦虚，紫罗兰色的头发，她的名字萦绕在他的舌尖，一个他渴望一次又一次重复的名字，脸上挂着梦幻般的微笑：“Le-e-na……”她总是在附近的某个地方，当他的目光与她相遇时，她就会脸红。就这样，他的心跳开始加快。

但时间很短。距离轮班结束只剩下一周时间了。那之后呢？他会被扔回冰冷的世界吗？离开这里，在这个奇怪的夏日童话故事中？或者……其他什么？

虽然也许，对他来说，这并不重要。也许无论如何什么都不会改变。
因为这个女孩剩下的时间已经不多了。太少了……

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3533712894]Steam[/url]]
